simple.meaning: שׁוּלַמִּית (Shûwlammîyth) is a Hebrew word meaning “peaceful (with the article always prefixed, making it a pet name); the Shulammith , an epithet of Solomon's queen.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שׁוּלַמִּית (H7759) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Song of Songs 7:1, with occurrences in Song of Solomon.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׁוּלַמִּית (H7759) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שׁוּלַמִּית (H7759) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שׁוּלַמִּית (Shûwlammîyth) / H7759 is traced through Song of Songs 7:1 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
